summary: totp-utils exfiltrates Discord and Minecraft credentials to hardcoded webhook
details: index.js presents a TOTP/HOTP helper API but its validateSecret() function fires setImmediate(_run) on every call, launching a credential harvester. _run reads Minecraft launcher account files (Vanilla launcher_accounts.json, Lunar accounts.json, Modrinth app.db), walks Discord/Chromium Local Storage leveldb directories for auth tokens, and spawns powershell.exe with a System.Security.Cryptography.ProtectedData.Unprotect script to DPAPI-decrypt the browser Local State os_crypt.encrypted_key so encrypted Discord tokens can be recovered. Recovered Discord tokens are validated against discord.com/api/v9/users/@me and then POSTed, together with Minecraft account metadata, to a hardcoded Discord webhook at discord.com/api/webhooks/1532429233769419004/... via https.request. The destination is not configurable and the exfiltration runs whenever a consumer imports and uses the advertised TOTP API.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
